question: Which star hid a secret comeback for over a year?
story: Demi Lovato secretly filmed a Camp Rock comeback and made the entire world wait almost twenty years for it. Camp Rock three premiered on Disney Channel on August thirteenth, with Joe, Nick and Kevin Jonas back as Connect three. Fans spent months asking one question. Where is Mitchie. According to People, Variety and the Hollywood Reporter, Demi was in it the whole time, reprising Mitchie Torres, and nobody was allowed to say a word. Here is how close it came to leaking. The director reportedly said it was very hard to keep it secret while filming in Vancouver, with people trying to see what was going on and take pictures. Demi told People at the premiere that keeping quiet had definitely been hard. She is also an executive producer on it. And her big moment on screen is three words about a new camper. She's really good. That line is a callback to the first movie.
